name: @pipeworx/mcp-coinmarketcap

tools.name: quotes
tools.description: Latest market quotes for one or more cryptocurrencies. Identify by symbol (e.g. "BTC,ETH") OR by id (CMC numeric IDs).

tools.name: listings_latest
tools.description: Paginated list of cryptocurrencies ranked by market cap (or volume/price-change); returns rank, price, market cap, 24h volume, and 24h change per coin. Sortable; up to 5000 results.

tools.name: metadata
tools.description: Static coin metadata — logo, description, website, social links.

tools.name: global_metrics
tools.description: Total market cap, 24h volume, BTC/ETH dominance, active cryptos.

tools.name: category
tools.description: Fetch all coins belonging to a CoinMarketCap category (e.g. DeFi, NFTs) by category id (obtain ids from the `categories` tool); returns price, market cap, and 24h change per coin.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-coinmarketcap forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the coinmarketcap pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
